findings: 2026-11-05: drafted for Mathematics 11 Unit 1 (owner request): English and a teacher-style Roman Urdu lesson; the book's content in order with our clearly labelled teaching notes; worked examples step by step with reasons; results verified with sympy.

Book correction: The number 1.2 is printed a second time: it was already used for “1.2 Equality of Two Complex Numbers”. In the book's order this section would be 1.3 (its next sub-heading is printed 1.3.1). The printed title is kept here without the number.

Book correction: 1. The question prints \u201cFactorize the + polynomial\u201d; the stray \u201c+\u201d should not be there: \u201cFactorize the polynomial P(z) = z^{3} - 3z^{2} + z + 5\u201d. 2. In the quadratic formula step the book prints z = 2 \pm 2i. Dividing 4 \pm 2i by 2 gives z = 2 \pm i. (With 2 \pm 2i the quadratic would be z^{2} - 4z + 8, not z^{2} - 4z + 5.)
